notes.title: Midnight in Salem - Controller Support
notes.notes:
Nancy Drew: Midnight in Salem 
Controller Notes - March 6, 2020

We just released an updated build for Nancy Drew: Midnight in Salem that provides players with the ability to use a game controller for gameplay! No longer are you confined to just using a mouse, with our latest update, you can now play with a game controller as well! This new feature is optional, so if you prefer using your mouse or trackpad, you may still do so. 

Simply plug in any game controller with a USB into your computer. The game should automatically recognize your controller, however there may be some additional settings you have to change. Start big picture mode and select Midnight in Salem in your Steam library. Select ‘Manage game’ ‘controller options’ and make sure the ‘Steam Input per-game setting’ is set to forced on. All player directions and button guides can be found within the game, but if you would like a quick run-down of how the buttons affect your navigation and puzzle experience, check out our video tutorial on YouTube! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tr-hJJc3gX4]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tr-hJJc3gX4[/url]

If you have any questions about setting up your game controller for Nancy Drew: Midnight in Salem, please email us at techsupport@herinteractive.com.

We hope you enjoy using a game controller playing Nancy Drew: Midnight in Salem for a totally new experience!

Please note:  every controller is unique with different button layouts and thus can behave differently

notes.title: Mac Achievements Patch
notes.notes:
Nancy Drew: Midnight in Salem
Patch Notes  - December 18
 
We just released a patch for Mac users that addresses the Achievement issue on Macs. 

• Achievements should now be displayed and unlocked as expected.
• Saved games are still available.
• Please remember to restart Steam in case Steam doesn't automatically download/install the update.
• It might take some time before the update is visible.

Thank you for your ongoing feedback!
